      "explanation": "At most one controller can hold a request in READY or BUSY. Together with lemma_3, a second controller cannot enter READY while one is occupied."
    },
    {
      "lemma": "property lemma_3; @(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) (((controllerA.state == IDLE) && (controllerB.state == IDLE) && (controllerC.state == IDLE)) || !active); endproperty",
      "explanation": "An occupied controller holds no pass token; with active low, sel is X and idle controllers cannot enter READY. Lemmas 2 and 3 jointly preserve this invariant, and lemma_1 then implies mutual exclusion of acks. The proof base requires reset to establish the initial states."
